macros.name: addtosubstitutions
macros.doc: You can add replacement pairs by repeated calls to \addtosubstitutions.

macros.name: boustrophedoninverse
macros.doc: A Rongorongo4 similar style boustrophedon is available with \boustrophedoninverse or \rongorongonize, where subsequent lines are rotated by 180° instead of mirrored.

macros.name: chickenize
macros.doc: Replaces every word of the input with the word “chicken”.

macros.name: gameofchicken
macros.doc: This is a temptative implementation of Conway’s classic Game of Life.

macros.name: guttenbergenize
macros.doc: Calling \guttenbergenize will not only execute or manipulate Lua code, but also redefine some TeX or LaTeX commands.

macros.name: matrixize
macros.doc: Replaces every glyph by a binary representation of its ASCII value.

macros.name: medievalumlaut
macros.doc: Changes every lowercase umlaut into the corresponding vocale glyph with a small “e” glyph above it to show the origins of the german umlauts coming from ae, oe, ue.

macros.name: pancakenize
macros.doc: This is a dummy command that does nothing.

macros.name: rainbowcolor
macros.doc: this command causes the text color to change gradually according to the colors of a rainbow.

macros.name: randomerror
macros.doc: Just throws a random TeX or LaTeX error at a random time during the compilation.

macros.name: randomfonts
macros.doc: Changes the font randomly for every character.

macros.name: randomuclc
macros.doc: Changes every character of the input into its uppercase or lowercase variant.

macros.name: tabularasa
macros.doc: Takes every glyph out of the document and replaces it by empty space of the same width.

macros.name: uppercasecolor
macros.doc: Makes every uppercase character in the input colored.
